turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want a gardening thing to do with my four year old. Something quick, she's not patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Cress is the classic for a reason. Sprinkle seeds on damp cotton wool and you'll see shoots in two or three days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two days, that's perfect. Can we make it fun?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Grow it in an empty eggshell with a face drawn on. The cress becomes hair, and she can give it a haircut with scissors.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh she'll love that. Then what?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then sunflowers or radishes. Radishes go from seed to plate in about a month, and they're bright red.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Will she actually eat a radish? She's

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Maybe not, but kids are much more likely to try food they grew themselves. Worth a go.
